stories.title: 603 people moved to Flintshire from outside the UK, and 754 went the other way, new ONS data shows
stories.summary: More people left Flintshire for countries outside the UK than moved here from them in the twelve months to June 2025, figures published by the Office for National Statistics this morning show. stories.title: “Some relief this morning”: police log a clear night after run of Flintshire fires
stories.summary: North Wales Police officers in north Flintshire reported no arson incidents overnight, after a run of fires in the open across the county. stories.title: Darts venue approved for Connah’s Quay industrial unit despite neighbour’s safety warning
stories.summary: Plans to turn part of a Connah’s Quay industrial unit into an indoor darts venue have been approved, despite a neighbouring business warning of a safety risk in the shared yard. stories.title: Airbus order backlog passes 9,200 aircraft as deliveries rise at half year
stories.summary: Airbus has 9,222 commercial aircraft still on its order book, the company said on Wednesday, after delivering 351 in the first half of 2026 with wings built at Broughton. stories.title: Chester Zoo launches 5,000 mile challenge to raise £10,000 for tiger conservation
stories.summary: Chester Zoo has launched a month long fundraising challenge for tiger conservation, asking supporters to cover 5,000 miles between them and raise £10,000.
